- High-voltage 4.5 V NCM523||graphite cells are needed, but the state-of-the-art EC-based electrolyte fails by rollover fading
- Comparison axis: 1.0 M LiPF6 in EC:EMC 3:7 by wt. (EC-based) versus 1.0 M LiPF6 in EMC (EC-free)

- On the EC-based graphite anode, transition-metal deposits and Li dendrites sit at the same localized spots; the EC-free anode has no such spots

key.answer_key: No. At the 100 um field of view shown in the two SEM frames, only diffuse bright patches are resolved; no dendrite morphology is visible in either panel, so the co-location of transition-metal deposits and Li dendrites cannot be confirmed from these images (a1).
key.grading: Answer key: the audit ruling on the panel (a1), covering panels 10.1002/aenm.202003738#F4a and #F4b.
